findings.title: Same NPE path left unguarded in the paged subgroup stream methods
findings.body: The fix makes getSubGroupsCount() null-safe, but the sibling methods getSubGroupsStream(search, firstResult, maxResults) (line 256), getSubGroupsStream(firstResult, maxResults) (line 262) and getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, firstResult, maxResults) (line 268) still call modelSupplier.get() and dereference the result directly. If the group was deleted concurrently, modelSupplier.get() returns null and these throw the same NullPointerException the PR is meant to fix. The concurrent-read scenario from the issue is therefore only partly addressed.

findings.title: Deleted group silently reports a null subgroup count
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() now returns null when the backing group no longer exists. Callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass this straight to setSubGroupCount, so a group that was removed mid-request is returned with a null count instead of being treated as missing. Returning null here hides the deletion rather than surfacing it, and the other GroupAdapter methods throw IllegalStateException('Not found in database') in the same situation, so behaviour is now inconsistent.

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined, so the assertion can pass without reading concurrently
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a reader thread, deletes the groups, sets deletedAll to true and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty. There is no join on the reader thread, so the assertion may run before the reader has performed any reads or observed any exceptions. The test can pass vacuously and does not reliably detect the race it is meant to cover. The reader thread is also not stored, so an exception thrown inside it outside the try block would be lost. The test should join the thread (and ideally fail on any exception it records) before asserting.

findings.title: Concurrency regression test is not shown to reproduce the original NPE
findings.body: The test is a best-effort race with no deterministic trigger, and the reader loop is a busy spin with no sleep. Nothing in the PR shows that it fails on the base commit, so it may not guard against regression of the NPE. The name 'groupUuuids' is also a typo.

findings.title: Unrelated private helper removed in a bug-fix PR
findings.body: The private method groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement is deleted here, but this change is not part of the NPE fix described in the PR. It is out of scope for the stated purpose and should be in a separate change or justified in the description. Any imports it depended on, such as StringUtil, should also be checked for being left unused.
